game.title: Los Angeles Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

lede: Kansas City Chiefs carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#12 in EPA per play), while Los Angeles Chargers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#4 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Kansas City Chiefs -4.2 with a fair total of 39.6 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Chargers pass offence vs Kansas City Chiefs pass defence, which sits −0.140 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Los Angeles Chargers and Kansas City Chiefs have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
